Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000307": The catalog service's joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000305" [decision]: As of 2025-04-04, the catalog service will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000298": As of 2025-04-04, the notifier lives with Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, notifier)
- memory_id "1000283": As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service.  (about: Team Boreal, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000263": As of 2025-03-24, Farah still has the Team Dune pager.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000261" [constraint]: The catalog service only ships on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000254": As of 2025-03-20, Team Dune owns the catalog service.  (about: Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000250": As of 2025-03-20, the pager for the catalog service rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000232": The ledger relies on the auth gateway for service tokens, so if the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down.  (about: ledger, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000204": Team Cinder holds planning on Mondays.  (about: Team Cinder)
- memory_id "1000201": The indexer depends on the catalog service for product documents.  (about: catalog service, indexer)
- memory_id "1000180": Team Cinder flagged that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade.  (about: Team Cinder, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000176": Yuki handed the Team Cinder pager to Diego on 2025-02-21.  (about: Team Cinder, Yuki, Diego)
- memory_id "1000170": The notifier's flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.  (about: notifier, push provider)
- memory_id "1000150": INC-2025-004 was an incident affecting the notifier on 2025-02-06.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000147" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the auth gateway deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.  (about: auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000114": The notifier depends on the event bus for delivery events.  (about: event bus, notifier)
- memory_id "1000108": The indexer lives with Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000090": Yuki takes the first Team Cinder on-call shift of the year.  (about: Team Cinder, Yuki)
- memory_id "1000021": Team Cinder consists of Yuki and Diego.  (about: Team Cinder, Yuki, Diego)
Existing entity names: catalog service, Team Cinder, notifier, Team Boreal, auth gateway, Farah, Team Dune, ledger, indexer, Yuki, Diego, push provider, INC-2025-004, event bus
